notes: Account: In-house dev platform + hosted code search product used by 600+ engineers.
Primary ask: replace a brittle ES+Lambda reranker pipeline with a unified embeddings + rerank stack that meets p95 latency targets and reduces cost per query.
Corpus size: ~22M code & engineering docs across monorepos; embeddings updated incrementally (avg 500k vectors/day).
Key constraints: frequent re-index (daily deltas), sub-200ms p95 rerank latency for single-shot queries, SSO via SAML + strict audit log retention (1 year).
Quote from CTO: 'We need parity with our current relevancy and strict SLA for developer-facing search — can't be slower than today.'
Cost sensitivity: looking to cut per-query infra spend by 40% vs current Lambda/ES setup; internal target <$0.01/query for rerank+NN search.
Model preferences: open models for reranking (quantized variants acceptable), must support fast CPU fallbacks for low-cost queries, GPU for heavy rerank ops.
Routing/fallback: want policy that favors private-dedicated region, fallback to lower-cost model variant during spikes, cross-region read-only fallbacks for DR.
Security: SAML SSO + SCIM for provisioning, customer-managed KMS, retention controls for logs, need SOC2/ISO artifacts for procurement team.

Evaluation plan: three-week perf POC: 1) ingest 20M embeddings (approx 160GB float16), 2) run hybrid ANN + learned reranker sim workload (QPS 200 sustained), 3) measure p50/p95 latency and cost per QPS.
Internal champion: Head of Developer Experience (Alex Rivera) — will provide sample queries and golden relevancy sets.
AE notes: send POC instructions + exact dataset snapshot; include repro script for current ES baseline for apples-to-apples cost/latency comparison.
Tech notes: worried about cold-start KV cache warming with daily re-index; ask Redwood about incremental index APIs and prefix/KV cache strategies.
Procurement: prefers 12mo reserved capacity if POC results within targets; needs pricing with delta for re-index-heavy workload.
Next demo: can do live run week of 2025-03-17 with SE and infra lead from Inkwell.

requirements_summary: Workload type: large-scale embeddings + learned reranking for code search and internal docs
Scale: 20M+ vectors, ~500k updates/day (delta indexing), expected QPS: 150-250 during peak, avg 60
Latency targets: p50 < 60ms (ANN lookup), p95 end-to-end rerank < 200ms (including network + reranker model)
Cost sensitivity: target <$0.01 per complex query (ANN + rerank); willing to trade slight latency increase for cost savings during non-peak
Indexing: need efficient incremental re-index API, partial shards, and zero-downtime rollouts for embeddings; want checkpointed offload to S3 compatible storage
Models: prefer open rerankers (distil or quantized T5 variants), fallback to CPU lexical search for cheap queries
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency heatmaps, regressions alerting on golden query sets
Security/compliance: SAML SSO + SCIM, customer-managed KMS/HSM support, one-year audit log retention, EU residency for EU traffic
Deployment preference: Private (VPC) with option to burst to Dedicated during heavy re-index windows
